**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The white plate is roughly square, about 22 cm across. Vessel area is about 480 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** One cluster of about 14 red seedless grapes, each roughly 2.2 cm in diameter. No oil, dressing, or sauce is visible.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The grapes cover about 10% of the plate (about 48 cm²), since they sit in a compact pile of roughly 8 × 9 cm.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** 48 cm² × about 2 cm average pile height ≈ 96 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** 96 ml × 0.6 g/ml (fruit pieces) ≈ 58 g. Counting the grapes at about 4–5 g each (14 grapes ≈ 60–70 g) gives a consistent figure, so I use 60 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Red grapes are about 69 kcal per 100 g. 60 g × 0.69 ≈ 41 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 14 grapes is roughly 60 g and about 40 kcal, which is plausible for a small handful of grapes.
